title: High-dimensional quality-diversity optimization via natural-gradient covariance matrix adaptation, archive soft-threshold annealing, and frontier novelty guidance
coding_guidance: Edit only model.py; never modify eval.py/data.py/task_spec.json. Preserve optimize_qd(task, config) returning a dict with 'archive_q' (g x g float array, -inf for empty cells) and 'archive_x' (g x g x d float array of elite solutions) using at most task['budget_generations'] * task['batch_size'] evaluations via evaluate_candidates(X, task). Never access hidden task['opt_center'], task['rot_Q'], task['proj_B'], or task['eig_weights'] directly—only call evaluate_candidates(X, task) and archive_cell_indices(desc, g). CRITICAL DESIGN REQUIREMENTS: (1) CMA-MAE ARCHIVE SOFT-THRESHOLD ANNEALING & RANK-MU COVARIANCE MATRIX ADAPTATION: Maintain a soft archive acceptance threshold t_e initialized to t_min and updated via t_e <- (1 - alpha_a) t_e + alpha_a f(x) so Improvement emitters rank candidates by Delta_i = f(x_i) - t_{cell(x_i)} (discovering new cells with high priority while steadily climbing quality in occupied cells), and update the emitter search mean m and diagonal/low-rank covariance matrix C via rank-mu natural-gradient evolution path updates. (2) FRONTIER NOVELTY / SPARSE-NEIGHBORHOOD BOUNDARY DISCOVERY & SURROGATE INTERPOLATION: Guide a subset of offspring along the local descriptor Jacobian / finite-difference direction between high-performing adjacent archive elites toward unoccupied frontier cells, and refine top elites via local quadratic/ridge surrogate interpolation. (3) Expose clean orthogonal boolean config switches: cma_covariance_adaptation (default True), archive_threshold_annealing (default True), frontier_boundary_guidance (default True), local_surrogate_refinement (default True), dimension_adaptive_smoothing (default True).
metric_description: Quality-Diversity loss mse = 1.0 - normalized_qd_score across dimensions d in [24, 36, 48, 64], reporting QD-Score, Archive Coverage (%), Mean Elite Quality, and CVaR-10% Tail Quality against Vanilla MAP-Elites (arXiv:2009.08438), CMA-ME (arXiv:1912.02400), and Fixed-Annealing CMA-MAE (arXiv:2205.10752) with paired Student-t 95% CIs and complete 2x2 factorial mechanism isolation.
